Regulatory clearance enables U.S. commercialization, a potential revenue driver.
Wider clinical utility can increase procedure adoption and device sales.
Use beyond liver enlarges addressable market for the device line.
Workflow flexibility can speed uptake among interventional radiologists.
Near-term launch timing offers a catalyst for early sales traction.

This is an expansion of TriSalus’s device portfolio, reinforcing a commercialization push in liver-directed and related procedures. A successful rollout with adoption metrics or revenue contribution would turn this into a stronger catalyst.
